Got Any Questions?

What exactly is an AI Agent?

Engagements start at $4.5k for a single quick-fix automation, $18k for a full 6-week implementation, or $8k/mo for ongoing partnership. Every quote is fixed-scope — no surprise invoices.

What tools can the AI Agent connect to?

AI Agents can connect with platforms like Slack, HubSpot, Notion, Shopify, and custom APIs. Integrations are tailored to your workflow, ensuring seamless data exchange and efficient automation across your existing tools.

How do we measure if the AI Agent is successful?

Performance is measured through accuracy, response times, task completion, and customer satisfaction. Continuous monitoring helps identify opportunities for improvement and ensures the AI delivers measurable business value.

What metrics can we use to evaluate user satisfaction?

User satisfaction is evaluated through feedback scores, resolution rates, response quality, and engagement levels. These metrics provide valuable insights and help maintain a consistently positive experience.

How frequently should we conduct performance reviews of the AI?

Performance reviews are typically conducted monthly or quarterly based on usage and business needs. Regular evaluations ensure the AI remains accurate, efficient, and aligned with evolving goals.

What benchmarks are essential for assessing AI effectiveness?

Key benchmarks include accuracy, automation rates, response speed, and customer satisfaction. These indicators help measure overall impact and ensure the AI continues delivering reliable results.

How long does it take to design and deploy an AI Agent?

Deployment timelines vary based on complexity, integrations, and project requirements. Most AI Agents can be planned and launched within a few weeks with a structured implementation process.
